title: Poor Customer Service
text:
Poor Customer Service. Very salty, does not taste like butter, remains powdery. No instructions on how to use
No response from Hoosier Farms when I wrote asking for instructions. When I contacted Amazon I was told to contact Hoosier, even though I purchased through Amazon Prime.

product_metadata.title: Real Butter Powder by Hoosier Hill Farm, 2LB (Pack of 1)
features: Delicious butter powder made with real sweet cream butter
Makes a great addition to soups, sauces, and mixes
Hoosier Hill Farm Real Butter Powder is the ingredient of choice for cooks searching to improve performance without compromising quality or product integrity
Use Butter Powder in place of churned butter in any recipe
To reconstitute, mix 1 part butter powder with 1 part water
Store in a cool, dry place. We do not recommend refrigeration or freezing of the powder.
Allergens: Contains milk. Packaged in a facility that processes dairy, soy, peanuts, and wheat products.
